description: I'm so busy that this is becoming the almost weekly update!!Yesterday, April 7th, I attended a round table discussion about the tax situation in Montana. I learned a LOT, and I'm anxious to share with you what I learned. What did I learn from Use Your Voice: A Civil Conversation on Tax Policy? I learned how little I actually knew about Montana Tax Policy, the tax code, and how it works! Based on that, and what I learned from our bipartisan panel of experts, here is my official campaign platform
